sup:70710.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
sup:70710.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some insight into our cost environment: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
message.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

You described a cost environment of alloy and material pressure, and Option A below answers it with a longer contract term and a firm price for the supplier to plan on.

On the alloy surcharge:
The alloy surcharge for stainless grade 316L changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).

On bar prices:
German producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.1% from 2026-05 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

On our own purchase history:
Our orders of Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm, peeled with you were placed at EUR 5.45 on 2024-10-07 (po:4500011523-10), EUR 5.33 on 2025-06-05 (po:4500012560-10), EUR 5.24 on 2026-01-26 (po:4500013482-10) and EUR 5.45 on 2026-09-24 (po:4500014455-10): the price has not risen.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.99; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.96; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.95; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. It is short enough to approve as it stands.

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. As to the index change data you cited, that is not our reality: our AS-14404 is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, so that fall does not reach our cost. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. 

We acknowledge the index movements you cited; however, our alloy requirements are covered at fixed prices until March 2027, meaning these reductions do not currently reach our costs. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. We cannot offer a fixed price for a 24-month term, so we have introduced an AS-14404 index clause to make this extended duration possible. 

Our current Angebot is a price of €5.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Building on your Option C, we propose €5.32 per unit with 45 days payment and a 24-month contract. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.32 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

This proposal stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

You said a fixed price over the full term is unfeasible and that you need protection against alloy movements. None of our options contains an index clause, so the price in Option A is fixed for the whole term and you can plan on it from the first delivery to the last.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives you the highest unit price of the three, the longest contract term to plan on, and a price that needs no adjustment mechanism or review during the term.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.05; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.02; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.01; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.

As this will probably need sign-off on your side, please take Option A to the person who decides on pricing. For that person: Option A gives Edelstahl-Service Donautal the highest unit price we are offering, a fixed price for the whole contract term and a firm customer for that period. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Thank you for offering to adjust your terms so far. What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your preference for Option A and your willingness to find an agreement. It is always a pleasure working with you to support your ongoing requirements from our range.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.05 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

To confirm a 24-month contract with a 90-day payment term, we strictly require the AS-14404 index clause, as a fixed price over this duration is unfeasible. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. 

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 90 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, we can provide an option at a price of €5.22 per unit with a contract term of 24 months. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
